text:
Predicates:
RankedHighly(x) ::: x is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
ActivePlayer(x) ::: x is one of the most active players in major tennis.
LostTo(x, y) ::: x lost to y.
IgaSwiatek ::: Iga Świątek.
RolandGarras2022(x) ::: x participated in Roland Garros 2022.
Female(x) ::: x is female.
Male(x) ::: x is male.
TennisPlayer(x) ::: x is a tennis player.

Premises:
∀x (RankedHighly(x) → ActivePlayer(x)) ::: If someone is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association, then they are one of the most active players in major tennis.
∀x (LostTo(x, IgaSwiatek) → RankedHighly(x)) ::: Everyone who lost to Iga Świątek at Roland Garros 2022 is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
∀x (TennisPlayer(x) ∧ RolandGarras2022(x) → (Female(x) ∧ LostTo(x, IgaSwiatek))) ::: All female tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Iga Świątek.
∀x (TennisPlayer(x) ∧ RolandGarras2022(x) → (Male(x) ∨ Female(x))) ::: All tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 are either female or male.
∀x (Male(x) ∧ RolandGarras2022(x) → LostTo(x, RafaelNadal)) ::: All male tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Rafael Nadal.
( (RankedHighly(CocoGauff) ∨ LostTo(CocoGauff, RafaelNadal)) → ¬Male(CocoGauff) ) ::: If Coco Gauff is ranked highly or lost to Rafael Nadal, then Coco Gauff is not a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
CocoGauff ∧ RolandGarras2022(CocoGauff) ::: Coco Gauff is at Roland Garros 2022.
